subject: Intermittent Connectivity Interruptions at Hospital
body: An unexpected service interruption took place, impacting various applications. The problem may be linked to recent changes made to the firewall. Services were restarted, caches were cleared, and connectivity was checked; however, the issue persists. The problem continues, obstructing access to medical data.
issue: Minor: the customer lists all the troubleshooting they did and says the issue is still not resolved. It ends without an explicit request

subject: Guidelines for Notifying Service Disruptions and Upcoming Maintenance
body: Customer Support is seeking guidance on scheduling maintenance windows for our SaaS project management platform. Could you provide details on how to report service disruptions? Additionally, we would like to know about specific tools and resources that can assist with this process.
issue: Minor: high priority for an information request

subject: Help Required for Service Interruption
body: I am facing difficulties in accessing medical data because of a network outage. The issue might stem from a network configuration error or a security breach. Kindly be assured that all measures are being taken to minimize the impact of this interruption and to safeguard patient care.
issue: Starts as a customer ("I am facing difficulties…") but ends with "Kindly be assured that all measures are being taken…", which reads like a reply to the customer, not a request from one

subject: Report on Unforeseen Service Disruption
body: Customer Support has documented intermittent service disruptions impacting the project management SaaS. Initial diagnostic measures such as system reboots and log checks have been implemented, but the issues still persist. Steps already taken include restarting the services and checking the network connectivity.
issue: First and last sentences are identical to syn_bd5077d6cb9f, so it is nearly a copy of another synthetic record. It also lists the measures taken while troubleshooting and ends without a request

body: Customer Support, I am submitting a request to improve the scalability of our system to prevent service interruptions that affect several key software and hardware products. Our team is ready and willing to provide any necessary information to help facilitate a swift resolution. This includes conducting a thorough investigation into the causes of the outages and implementing robust security measures.
issue: No subject. Stitched ending: "This includes conducting a thorough investigation…" does not follow from "swift resolution", and a scalability request turns into investigating outage causes and adding security measures

subject: Urgent Attention Required for Medical Data Protection
body: Customer support team, I am requesting an update to the digital strategy to boost brand growth across various product campaigns during the scheduled maintenance window. Recent service disruptions have compromised the integrity of sensitive medical information, which poses a risk to patients. Kindly inform me of any additional steps required and the necessary information I need to provide.
issue: Off-topic: digital strategy and brand growth request in an outage ticket; subject is about medical data, body mixes topics

subject: Support for Service Interruptions
body: Customer support has received a request to revise the digital strategy to enhance brand development and reduce service interruptions. We are reaching out to request immediate assistance with ongoing service outages affecting multiple of our products, particularly the project management solutions. This outage is causing major inconveniences at work. Additionally, the integrated hardware and software are not functioning as intended, which has led to decreased productivity.
issue: Off-topic: opens with a request to revise the digital strategy for brand development, then reports outages

subject: Support Needed for Website Crash
body: Several essential products experienced failures, affecting data analysis processes. We would greatly appreciate any support you can offer to restore our website to normal operation. So far, we have tried restarting the applications and clearing the cache, but these steps haven't been successful. Troubleshooting efforts included restarting affected devices and checking network connectivity, but the problem continues and requires immediate assistance to fix and prevent further disruptions to operations.
issue: Longest body (69 words, median 46); two separate sentences list troubleshooting steps; long last sentence packs several points together

subject: Report on Service Interruptions
body: Dear Customer Support, I am writing to request an update to our maintenance schedule. I look forward to hearing from you soon. Please let us know if there is any additional information needed.
issue: No outage content: a generic request to "update our maintenance schedule" plus two boilerplate closers; the subject ("Report on Service Interruptions") does not match the body; high priority is not justified

subject: System Interruption
body: Currently encountering service disruptions on essential digital platforms. The root cause remains uncertain, possibly linked to the network infrastructure. I have already attempted to restart applications and clear cache, but the problem still persists. After restarting the services and reviewing the logs, the root cause has not been identified yet.
issue: Same subject and "root cause remains uncertain" sentence as syn_42ad7797de51; troubleshooting repeated
